hero.lead: Navby weighs price, layovers and duration at the same time and tells you which flight makes sense. No fifteen open tabs. No commissions.

statement.label: Why Navby
statement.text: Finding a flight shouldn't cost you an afternoon. Search engines hand you a hundred and fifty results and make you choose between the cheap one that takes forty hours and the direct one you can't afford. Navby does the hard part: it balances price, layovers and speed, and gives you the flight that truly makes sense.

how.title: From idea to seat, in three steps.

steps.title: Tell us where you're going
steps.text: Origin, destination and dates. One-way or round trip, between any two cities.

steps.title: Navby weighs it all
steps.text: It compares thousands of combinations and evaluates price, layovers and duration together, not one at a time.

steps.title: Book direct
steps.text: We send you to the airline's official site. The price you see is the price you pay.

product.title: A recommendation, not a list.
product.lead: Navby shows you the flights that actually make sense, with the route on the map and the fare verified to the minute.

mock.why: Best balance of price, layovers and duration

features.title: Balance, not extremes
features.text: Not the cheapest thirty-hour trip, not the unaffordable nonstop. The recommended flight is the one that best balances what you care about.

features.title: Real fare, direct link
features.text: We quote live and send you to the official seller. Navby adds no commission and never inflates the price.

features.title: Your route, in plain sight
features.text: Every connection drawn on a flat map: where you stop and how long you wait, before you buy.

board.title: No fine print.
board.lead: Everything we promise fits on a departures board.
